newsitem.title: GERMANY: Colonia says aims for higher 97 profit. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Colonia says aims for higher 97 profit. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]

text.p: COLOGNE, Germany, June 10 - German insurance group Colonia AG said on Tuesday it aimed for higher earnings in 1997 after its sales advanced 3.8 percent (corrects from "5.9 percent") in the first five months of the year.

Colonia said its premium income from January through May rose to five billion marks (corrects from "1.6 billion marks") Life premiums rose 5.9 percent to 1.6 billion marks. (Corrects premium figure, makes clear that 5.9 percent rise refers to life premiums only).

Chief executive Claas Kleyboldt told the company's shareholder meeting it should be possible to achieve growth above the market average this year, despite an increasingly difficult operating environment.
Colonia reported net profit of 236 million marks ($138.2 million).
